ValidationRule.description: Requires comments when a Zoho Tasks checklist item status is changed to On Hold.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "On Hold"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Checklist_Item_Type__c, "Zoho Tasks"), TEXT(Course_Checklist__r.Checklist_Type__c) = "Zoho Tasks" ), LEN(TRIM(Comments__c)) = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Comments are required when setting Zoho Tasks checklist items to On Hold.
